description: Web page reader for agents: fetch one public URL and get clean Markdown or text of the main content plus title, description, canonical, language, dates, headings and absolute links. Strips nav, scripts and cookie banners; follows redirects; handles JSON/text. Honors robots.txt and never bypasses logins or bot blocks. Errors are not charged: 400 bad URL, 422 robots/404/blocked, 502 unreachable. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/web/read.

links.description: include link list and inline Markdown links, default 1

name: web_read
title: Web page reader (clean Markdown + metadata)
